rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_constrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=300, recon_eta=60.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=True, recon_dcstep_every=3, recon_dcstep_n_cg=20, recon_dcstep_warmup=0, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, val_n=6, train_n=0, seed=42, rationale=iter-12 EARLY-DC-ANCHOR: recon_dcstep_warmup 25->0 at the eta=60/every=3/n_cg=20/steps=300 peak. ALL sampling-fidelity + DC-strength knobs are exhausted at the 0.845-0.848 plateau (eta peaked 60=0.8452, 90 overshot 0.840; every=8 dropped 0.835; n_cg 10->20 flat 0.8459; steps 200->300 flat 0.8476). The untouched axis is the DC GATE: with warmup=25 the hard-DC projection stays off for the first 25 reverse steps, letting the constrained DDPM prior drift the FBP-init OFF the measurement manifold during the high-noise early trajectory before periodic hard-DC re-engages. Hyp: warmup 25->0 anchors the reverse path to the measurements from step 0, holding it data-consistent throughout and lifting SSIM above the eta/n_cg/steps plateau. val_n=6 + steps=300 unchanged (single-knob).
